page.overview:
Who is Titus Crow?

Titus Crow is a fictional character created by Brian Lumley for the eponymous Cthulhu Mythos series Titus Crow.

Originally an occultist with a vast knowledge of the history, creatures, and motivations of the in-universe Mythos, Crow also had in his possession a number of artefacts related to the topic. He has displayed an unwavering resolution in stopping the schemes of the Great Old Ones and their minions, even to the point of apparent self-sacrifice.

Later rebuilt to be better in every way after a catastrophic accident, Crow became a persistent nemesis to the Cthulhu Cycle Deities, and Ithaqua in particular.

Lumley's 1987 short story "Inception" reveals the Crow's vast mystical knowledge to stem from being unwittingly baptised in a mind-expanding liquid.
